title: If you sat down all day, every day, how long until you die?

lines.text: If you sat down all day, every single day, how long would it take for you to die?
Day one. Thirty minutes in your chair, and your leg muscles go almost silent.
Day three. Desk, car, sofa, bed. Your blood sugar now spikes after every meal.
Month one. Tight hips, sleepy glutes, and an aching back.
Sitting is the new smoking? Not quite. An hour of brisk walking a day cancels most of the risk. You walk zero.
Your blood pressure is way too high. Walk every thirty minutes.
lines.speaker: doctor

lines.text: Year two. A twelve-hour gaming session. Blood pools in your calf, and clots.
Then it breaks loose, shoots to your lungs, and blocks them.
You died. Comment what stupid shenanigans Gary should try tomorrow.
